HZGTovJu_TQ.title: If You Can't See the Nearest Star, How Far Away Is It?
HZGTovJu_TQ.description:
How Far Is the Nearest Star?
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=c5AdqQsnnys

Proxima Centauri is the nearest star to the Sun at about 4.24 light-years away, yet it gives out less than one percent of the Sun's light and is too faint to see with the naked eye.

Sources: Gaia Collaboration, Vallenari et al. 2023 (A&A 674, A1), Gaia DR3 parallax for Proxima Centauri (4.24 light-years) · Kervella, Thévenin & Lovis 2017 (A&A 598, L7).

Pictures: ESO Paranal and La Silla southern night-sky time-lapses (CC BY 4.0) and NASA/ESA Hubble imagery (CC BY 4.0), alongside AI-assisted voice and editing. Facts: every number is checked against the sources listed above.
Image credits: ESO; NASA/ESA Hubble.
